sentences: A man stands on a rocky summit, looking out over an endless sea of fog.
Friedrich often painted figures from behind; because we cannot see his expression, we naturally step into his place and look at the view with him.
He stands at the exact center of the canvas, and the ridgelines on both sides converge on him.
The rocks rising from the mist come from real mountains in Saxony that Friedrich sketched and then combined into one imagined panorama.
It is perhaps the clearest image of the sublime, the awe and fear before overwhelming nature that lay at the heart of Romanticism.
